name: consult
description: A mod that registers the mcp__consult__consult tool: a read-only diff or plan review by the codex (OpenAI) or agy (Google Gemini) CLI, with a repo opt-out marker, a secret-file block, timeouts and a read-only agy hook gate.

codexSocket.title: Codex app server socket
codexSocket.description: Unix socket of the running codex app server (README: Run the codex app server). Empty: $XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/codex-consult.sock. Allowed characters: A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ / -
